entries.title: JSE Market Notice 158A (29 Oct 2013) - Proposed amendments to the Equities Directives - Closing Price Cross Session (file 2013_163B)
entries.notes: Closing price cross session introduced with the 2013 upgrade. Retrieved via https://web.archive.org/web/2025id_/https://clientportal.jse.co.za/Content/JSENoticesandCircularsItems/2013_163B.pdf.

entries.title: JSE Market Notice 171 (6 Dec 2013) - JSE pauses trade to mark the passing of Nelson Mandela (session tables)
entries.notes: "all JSE markets will be paused for 5 minutes at 11am on Friday, 6 December 2013"; re-opening auction 11:05, normal close. Retrieved via https://web.archive.org/web/2025id_/https://clientportal.jse.co.za/Content/JSENoticesandCircularsItems/171-06-12-2013-L.%20Parsons.pdf.

entries.title: JSE Market Notice 170 (6 Dec 2013) - JSE pauses trade to mark the passing of Nelson Mandela
entries.notes: Companion notice on the 6 December 2013 pause. Retrieved via https://web.archive.org/web/2025id_/https://clientportal.jse.co.za/Content/JSENoticesandCircularsItems/170-06-12-2013-L.%20Parsons.pdf.

entries.title: JSE Market Notice 67/2019 (4 Mar 2019) - Revised price monitoring extension during closing auction and circuit breakers
entries.notes: Latest closing-auction uncross moved from 17:16 to 17:10 (11 March 2019). entries.title: JSE Service Hotline 060/2020 (20 Mar 2020) - Update on JSE trading hours and circuit breakers (COVID-19)
entries.notes: "we would like to reiterate that normal trading hours will be maintained. To confirm, we will not be shortening trading hours, nor apply extended periods of market closure" (20 March 2020). Retrieved via https://web.archive.org/web/20240712035015id_/https://clientportal.jse.co.za/content/jsehotlinesitems/jse%20service%20hotline%2006020%20all%20markets%20-%20update%20on%20jse%20trading%20hours%20and%20circuit%20breakers.pdf.

entries.title: JSE Service Hotline 067/2020 (25 Mar 2020) - Update to early close threshold for the closing auction session
entries.notes: Closing-auction trigger for circuit-breaker-hit instruments "could be triggered as early as 16h40" (25 March 2020); per-instrument, not a market early close. Retrieved via https://web.archive.org/web/2024id_/https://clientportal.jse.co.za/content/jsehotlinesitems/jse%20service%20hotline%2006720%20eqm%20-%20update%20to%20early%20close%20threshold%20for%20the%20closing%20auction%20session.pdf.

entries.notes: Consultation on an early close on 5 April 2019 for the ITaC go-live (later moved). entries.title: JSE Market Notice 74B/2019 (7 Mar 2019) - All JSE markets closing earlier on 5 April 2019 (later cancelled)

entries.title: JSE Market Notice 104B/2019 (29 Mar 2019) - All JSE markets closing earlier on 26 April 2019 (no longer 5 April 2019)
entries.notes: "ALL JSE MARKETS CLOSING EARLIER ON 26 APRIL 2019 (NO LONGER 5 APRIL 2019)": continuous trading 09:00-14:50, closing auction call 14:50-15:00; 5 April 2019 a normal day. Retrieved via https://web.archive.org/web/20251025164939id_/https://clientportal.jse.co.za/content/jsenoticesandcircularsitems/jse%20market%20notice%2010419b%20all%20markets%20-%20jse%20markets%20closing%20early%2026%20april%202019.pdf.

entries.title: JSE Market Notice F4396 (30 Jul 2010) - Root cause of equity market trading disruption on 27 July 2010
entries.notes: "a network issue also caused the closure of the cash equities market for 90 minutes on 12 July 2010"; on 27 July 2010 "The cash equities market moved to an opening auction at 15h05 and continuous trading began at 15h20. Trading hours were extended by one hour and the market closed at 18h00." Retrieved via https://web.archive.org/web/2025id_/https://clientportal.jse.co.za/Content/JSENoticesandCircularsItems/NoteF4396.pdf.

entries.title: JSE Service Hotline 180/2017 (21 Sep 2017) - Delayed start to the Equity Market on 21 September 2017
entries.notes: Delayed start of the equity market on 21 September 2017; "The remainder of the trading day was unaffected". Retrieved via https://web.archive.org/web/2025id_/https://clientportal.jse.co.za/Content/JSEHotlinesItems/JSE%20Service%20Hotline%2018017%20EQM%20and%20EDM%20-%20Delayed%20Start%20to%20the%20Equity%20Market%20on%2021%20September%202017.pdf.

entries.title: JSE Service Hotline 175/2021 (23 Aug 2021) - Update on delay in start of trading 18 August 2021

entries.title: JSE Service Hotline 101/2022 (11 Jul 2022) - JSE All Markets Halt 6 July 2022
entries.notes: "The JSE took the decision to halt trade in all markets... All JSE markets reopened and went into continuous trading at 15h30 and normal market operations resumed for the remainder of the day."
